title: Excerpt of the shipped default bank

predictions.headline: Cheap renewables + storage are real
predictions.detail: In many markets utility-scale solar and wind paired with storage already undercut new fossil generation — the local fight is siting, grids, and who gets the electrons.

predictions.headline: Flood and leak sensors are deployable
predictions.detail: Cheap sensing is real; governance and maintenance decide whether alerts become action.

predictions.headline: More inference moves to the edge
predictions.detail: Smaller models and on-device chips make offline clinic and field assistants more honest for 2027+ claims — still narrow workflows, not general AGI.

predictions.headline: Autonomy expands on fixed routes first
predictions.detail: Mapped sites and corridors get more reliable autonomy before messy open environments.

predictions.headline: Geofenced driverless shuttles normalize
predictions.detail: Prediction: fixed-route, mapped shuttles become routine in some cities before open-road robotaxis everywhere.

predictions.headline: Near-real-time Earth observation for towns
predictions.detail: Prediction: denser constellations make local environmental monitoring routine for small cities that can pay and act.

predictions.headline: Rebuild robot swarms need humans
predictions.detail: Prediction: disaster rebuild uses more semi-autonomous machines under command; unsupervised city rebuild swarms stay fiction.
